Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Technical troubleshooting: Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues with industrial measurement equipment, electronic systems, and process control technologies. 

• Installation & commissioning: Install, configure, and commission advanced technical equipment at customer sites throughout the EMEA region. 

• Maintenance & repairs: Perform technical repairs, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis, both on-site and at the workshop in Merchtem. 

• Customer support: Provide professional technical assistance, both remotely and in person, ensuring customers receive efficient and reliable solutions. 

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

Do you have hands-on production planning experience and practical knowledge of ERP and Excel? Join us as a Planning Coordinator. Apply today!As a production planner, you coordinate the planning process from the arrival of machines and parts through assembly, technical checks and final delivery to the customer. 
• You plan and coordinate the process from incoming machines and parts to final delivery. 
• You ensure that parts, assembly activities and technical checks are scheduled correctly. 
• You monitor progress and adjust the production schedule when needed. 
• You coordinate closely with Supply Chain Management, the technical team and Sales. 
• You identify bottlenecks and help optimize production flow and capacity. 
• You accurately register incoming equipment and related information in the system.
What are we looking for in you? 
• You have relevant experience in production planning or a similar role. 
• You have hands-on experience with SAP or another ERP system. Theoretical knowledge alone is not sufficient. 
• You are proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel. 
• You have sufficient English skills for daily communication with colleagues and other departments.

Job description 

Do you love the open road and have your CE license? In this role, you will transport empty oil drums throughout Belgium and the Netherlands. Each day starts in Lier between 4 AM and 7 AM, where you will manage 3 to 8 stops with your mega trailer. We value your independence on the road, as you take full responsibility for your daily routes while enjoying a consistent starting point and a welcoming, stable team environment.

Your daily work offers plenty of variety, including attractive extra compensation for occasional physical tasks or Saturday shifts. We are looking for someone who stays flexible when working with different trailers and goods. You will join a company that truly appreciates your efforts, offering you a reliable role where you can rack up the miles. If you enjoy a mix of driving and hands-on work, you will find a great place with us.

 Requirements 

    
• Hold a valid CE driving license, Code 95, and a valid driver card.
    
• Possess proven experience with mega trailers.
    
• Excellent Dutch or English language skills, both spoken and written.
    
• Enjoy working with diverse trailers and goods in a varied, non-routine environment.
    
• Capable of performing physically demanding tasks with a positive, professional attitude.
    
• Have reliable own transportation to commute to the work site.

NEDERLANDS
Een nieuw gerecht bedenken is één ding. Ervoor zorgen dat het ook tijdens een drukke service even goed smaakt, vraagt iemand die naast het team in de keuken staat. Daarvoor zoeken we een Executive Chef.
 

Je ontwikkelt en test recepten, begeleidt onze keukenleads en helpt de centrale productie slimmer organiseren. Je kijkt naar smaak, porties, kostprijs en verspilling. Als een recept op papier klopt maar tijdens de service niet werkt, ga je met het team aan de slag tot het wel werkt. Je werkt vanuit Kortrijk met de keukenteams van Kurkumama Group. Voltijds of deeltijds, met een contract van bepaalde of onbepaalde duur.
 

Vertel ons over een gerecht of een keuken die jij beter hebt gemaakt. Solliciteer via https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs of jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.
 

ENGLISH
Coming up with a new dish is one thing. Making sure it tastes just as good in the middle of a busy service takes someone who’ll get in the kitchen with the team. That’s the Executive Chef we’re looking for.
 

You’ll develop and test recipes, coach our kitchen leads and improve how we work in the central kitchen. You’ll pay attention to flavour, portions, cost and waste. When a recipe works on paper but falls apart in service, you’ll work through it with the team. You’ll be based in Kortrijk and work with kitchen teams across Kurkumama Group. Full-time or part-time. A fixed-term or open-ended contract is possible.
 

Tell us about a dish or a kitchen you’ve helped make better. Apply at https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs or jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.

NEDERLANDS 
Bij Kurkumama koken we Perzisch eten zoals we het zelf graag eten. Onze khoresh heeft tijd nodig, dus je begint eraan lang voor de eerste bestelling. En als iemand het voor het eerst proeft, nemen we even de tijd om uit te leggen wat er in de pot zit.
 

We zoeken een kok die graag zelf aan het fornuis staat. Je zet de mise-en-place klaar, kookt en werkt de gerechten af. Als het druk wordt, hou je samen met de collega’s aan de counter het overzicht. Je proeft, stuurt bij waar nodig en laat je werkplek klaar achter voor de volgende shift.
 

Heb je nog nooit Perzisch gekookt? Dan leren we je graag onze gerechten kennen. Je kan voltijds of deeltijds aan de slag bij Kurkumama, Waterpoort 2 in Kortrijk, met een contract van bepaalde of onbepaalde duur. Vertel ons gerust wat jij graag kookt: https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs of jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.
 

ENGLISH 
At Kurkumama, we cook Persian food the way we like to eat it. Our khoresh takes time, so you start it well before the first order comes in. And when someone tries it for the first time, we take a moment to tell them what’s in the pot.
 

We’re looking for a cook who likes being at the stove. You’ll prep, cook and finish dishes. When it gets busy, you’ll work with the team at the counter to keep service moving. You’ll taste as you go, adjust when something needs it and leave the station ready for the next shift.
 

If you haven’t cooked Persian food before, we’ll teach you our dishes. Full-time or part-time at Kurkumama, Waterpoort 2, Kortrijk. A fixed-term or open-ended contract is possible. Tell us what you love to cook: https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs or jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.

You develop our presence in Flanders among professional advisors: accounting firms (10+ people), notaries, family offices and independent wealth advisors. Your job is to understand how these firms work with their private clients, identify where wealth planning creates value for them, and show how we help them deliver it.

This is consultative selling. Sales cycles typically run from 5 to 9 months, and up to 18 months with larger organisations. Your credibility with partners and senior advisors rests first on your understanding of their profession and of private wealth matters. Sales technique comes second.

We're a technology provider. Your role is to understand advisors' needs and the wealth issues they handle, not to advise their end clients.
What you will do
Prospecting and discovery

• Work from an existing, qualified target list of firms and decision-makers in Flanders
• Lead in-depth discovery conversations with partners to understand their practice, their clients' wealth issues and their growth ambition.
• Translate these needs into concrete use cases for our company.
Advising and convincing

• Discuss succession, gifting and wealth structuring topics with advisors on an equal footing, and connect them to what the platform does
• Run tailored demos built around realistic client situations
• Answer business and technical questions, and bring in product or domain experts when needed
• Follow opportunities over long cycles, from first conversation to signature
Pipeline and network

• Manage your opportunities and forecasts in HubSpot
• Develop your network through professional associations, events, webinars and partnerships
Collaboration

• Work closely with our VP Sales and our Revenue Team Lead
• Share field insights with Marketing and Product: client needs, objections, gaps What we are looking for
Essential

• In-depth knowledge of Belgian private wealth: succession and gift planning (including Flemish rules), matrimonial regimes, life insurance, holding and company structures, real estate, and the related tax aspects
• Professional experience in a wealth-related environment: private banking, wealth planning or management, insurance brokerage, estate planning, tax advice, accounting or notarial practice
• The ability to hold credible, substantive conversations with partners and senior advisor.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (our working language)
A strong plus

• Familiarity with how accounting firms, notaries or independent advisors work: business models, client relationships, regulatory constraints, current challenges
• An existing network among Flemish advisors
• French
Personal qualities

• Curiosity and rigour: you like to understand before you propose
• Patience and consistency over long cycles, and relationships built to last
• Sound commercial instinct: you sense when to move forward, when to wait, and how to turn a good conversation into an opportunity
• Autonomy and an entrepreneurial mindset: you shape the role as the market develops
Formal sales experience is not a prerequisite. If you come from accounting, tax or wealth advisory and want to move into business development, we would like to hear from you.
 What we offer
• Real ownership in a market where our company already has references, active leads and a qualified target list
• Close support from experienced colleagues in sales and wealth planning
• Room to grow as our company expands into new markets
• Hybrid work, with regular field presence in Flanders
• Employee or freelance status, a package based on seniority, and commission on sales

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S POWERING PROGRESS
 

 
 

Building cities. Driving commerce. Fueling Progress. For over 100 years, Allison has powered the vehicles and technology that move our world forward. 
What powers us? Our employees. From the first person hired by James Allison in 1915 to the thousands across the globe who work for Allison today, we’re driving progress everywhere because we employ top talent worldwide. In both the Allison Transmission and Allison Off-Highway Drive and Motion Systems business units, our team strives to Improve the Way the World Works.
 

 
 

Learn more about this role and how you can begin 
 driving your career forward!
 

 
 

Primary Purpose of Role: Teamlead Design & Drafting
 

The Team Lead Design & Drafting leads the Design and Drafting team and is responsible for delivering high-quality engineering design solutions and lifecycle management of drivetrain and gearbox products. The role ensures that product designs meet requirements related to quality, reliability, manufacturability, sustainability and cost efficiency, while supporting the successful execution of new product development projects and engineering changes.
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities
 

· Lead, coach and develop the Design and Drafting team.
 

· Drive employee engagement, performance management and talent development.
 

· Ensure high-quality and timely delivery of design activities for new product development projects.
 

· Oversee engineering changes, product documentation and bill of material governance.
 

· Monitor team workload, resource planning and operational KPIs.
 

· Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality and project stakeholders.
 

· Drive continuous improvement, standardization and automation initiatives.
 

· Support design reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards and processes.
 

· Maintain service parts lists and support the complete product lifecycle.
 

 
 

Scope Factors
 

· Direct leadership of 4 employees in Brugge and indirect coordination of 8 employees in India.
 

· Responsibility for engineering activities supporting projects with an annual value of approximately EUR 2 to 3 million.
 

· Department budget responsibility of approximately EUR 0.5 million.
 

· Oversight of approximately 1,000 design changes annually.
 

· Management of approximately 500 service parts list updates per year.
 

· Support of 1 to 2 new product development projects annually.
 

 
 

 
 

 

Competencies and Behaviors

·        Strong leadership and coaching capabilities.

·        Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

·        Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

·        Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple activities simultaneously.

·        Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

·        Organized and detail-oriented approach to work.

·        Collaborative team player with a customer-focused mindset.

·        Ability to work independently and make informed decisions.

 

Qualifications and Experience

·        Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent through experience.

·        Minimum 10 years of experience in gearbox design, drivetrain systems or a similar engineering environment.

·        Proven experience with CAD software, preferably PTC Creo.

·        Good understanding of manufacturing, assembly, quality and service operations.

·        Experience working with PLM and workflow systems such as Teamcenter.

·        Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

·        Fluent in English.

·        Good command of Dutch is an advantage; willingness to learn Dutch is required

Our client is a well-established international organisation operating in a fast-paced and data-driven environment. Based in Brussels, the company collaborates with stakeholders across multiple European markets and is committed to driving operational excellence through data, innovation and continuous improvement.As part of its continued growth, the organisation is looking to strengthen its analytics capabilities by hiring a Business Analyst / Data Analyst who will play a key role in supporting business operations and strategic decision-making.

Jobomschrijving

As a Data Analyst, you will support business and operational teams by ensuring accurate reporting, reliable data management and insightful performance analysis.Your main responsibilities will include:

• Developing and maintaining reporting tools, dashboards and performance indicators.
• Collecting, validating, consolidating and analysing data from various sources.
• Producing business performance reports and providing actionable recommendations to management.
• Supporting the automation, standardisation and optimisation of data processes.
• Building analytical tools to facilitate data-driven decision-making.
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of systems, processes and reporting methodologies
• Working closely with international stakeholders across different business functions.
• Participating in cross-functional projects related to operations, performance management, data governance and business development.

We are looking for a professional with approximately 2 to 3 years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Reporting, Commercial Controlling or a similar analytical role.Key qualifications and competencies include:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
• Previous experience working with data analysis and performance reporting.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Experience with SQL and data management tools.
• Knowledge of Power BI or similar Business Intelligence solutions is considered a strong asset.
• Strong analytical mindset with a passion for turning data into meaningful business insights.
• Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Professional proficiency in English and French.
